Acapulco Sunset Spread
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:46am

Ingredients




1 can Refried beans, (16 oz)
1/2 cup Salsa
8 ounces Neufchatel cheese, Softened
1 Avocado, pitted, peeled and chopped
1 tablespoon Fresh lime juice
1/2 pound Shrimp, cooked, small
1 Tomato, Chopped
Fresh cilantro, Optional
Tortilla chips

Preparation

1 1. In medium bowl, combine beans and salsa; mix well. Spread bean mixture onto serving plate. 2 2. Combine cheese, avocado and lime juice into a food processor bowl with metal blade or blender container and process until well blended. Spread cheese mixture over bean mixture. 3 3. Top with shrimp and tomato. Garnish or sprinkle with cilantro. Serve with tortilla chips.
